section: Whereas, the XML file generated by the Aadhaar number holder using Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC is digitally signed document using UIDAI digital signature. Thus, the service provider can verify the demographic contents of the file and certify it to be authentic when doing the offline verification Where can I find the Public Certificate for Digital Signature validation? Public certificate for Digital signature validation can be downloaded from here .
